description:
Sidebar collapse state is lost after restart

When the user collapses the left sidebar and quits the desktop app, the sidebar opens expanded again on the next launch. The collapsed or expanded state should be remembered per window and restored when the app starts.

Scope: the main window sidebar only; the right panel already remembers its width.

Done when: collapsing the sidebar, quitting and relaunching shows it collapsed; a new window starts expanded; unit tests cover the stored preference.

Agent run stops streaming when the laptop wakes from sleep

After the machine sleeps for a few minutes during a running agent conversation, the response stream in the conversation view freezes. The server keeps working and the answer is complete in history, but the open view never shows the rest until the page is reloaded.

The WebSocket reconnects, but the client does not resubscribe to the run's stream.

Done when: after sleep and wake the view continues showing new output without a reload; a reconnect test covers the resubscription.

Show token usage per conversation

Users want to know how many input and output tokens one conversation used and its estimated cost. Add a small summary under the conversation header with totals for the run, updated live while the agent is answering.

Pricing comes from the existing model pricing table; unknown prices show tokens only.

Done when: the header shows input, output and cost for a run; cost is hidden when the model has no price; the numbers match the token usage statistics page.

Terminal loses its scrollback when switching tabs

The integrated terminal clears its history when the user switches to another workspace tab and back. Long build logs disappear and cannot be scrolled anymore.

Keep each terminal session's scrollback buffer (up to the configured line limit) while its tab is hidden, and restore it when the tab becomes visible again.

Done when: switching away and back keeps the full scrollback; memory stays bounded by the line limit; a component test covers hide and show.

Dark mode contrast of code blocks is too low

In dark mode, inline code and fenced code blocks in agent messages use a gray text on a dark gray background that fails the WCAG AA contrast ratio. Comments in highlighted code are almost invisible.

Adjust the code theme colors for dark mode only; light mode stays as it is.

Done when: all code token colors reach at least 4.5:1 contrast in dark mode; a visual check of Markdown, diff and code blocks is recorded.

Relicense the core under AGPL with a commercial option

Companies can currently take the code, change it and sell a closed product. Move the open-source parts to AGPL-3.0 and offer a commercial licence for organisations that cannot meet the AGPL terms. Add a contributor licence agreement so contributions can be offered under both licences.

Done when: LICENSE files are updated in every package; README explains the dual licence; the CLA check runs on pull requests; third-party notices are complete.

File explorer does not show newly created files from agents

When an agent writes a new file into the workspace with its file tool, the file explorer tree does not show it until the user collapses and expands the folder. Edits to existing files appear, only new files are missing.

The watcher emits add events but the tree only applies change events for known nodes.

Done when: a file created by an agent appears in the open folder within a second; deleted files disappear; a test covers add and unlink events.

Speed up app startup on Windows

On Windows the desktop app takes about 12 seconds from the click to the first usable window, three times longer than on macOS. Profiling shows most time is spent scanning the agent package folders and verifying every bundled skill before the window is shown.

Move package verification after the first paint and load only what the first screen needs.

Done when: the window is usable within 4 seconds on the reference Windows laptop; package problems still show in the definitions view; startup timing is logged.

Let users rename a team run from the history list

Team runs are listed in history with an automatic name built from the first message, which is often long and unhelpful. Users want to give a run a short name of their own.

Add a Rename action to the run's menu in the history list and to the run header. The custom name is saved with the run and shown everywhere the run is listed.

Done when: renaming updates the list and header at once; the name survives a restart; an empty name restores the automatic one.

Docker image fails to start on ARM servers

The published server image crashes at startup on arm64 hosts with an exec format error from the Prisma query engine. Only the amd64 engine binary is copied into the image.

Build the image for both architectures and include the matching engine for each.

Done when: the multi-architecture image starts on an arm64 VPS and on amd64; a smoke test in the release workflow starts both variants; the README lists the supported platforms.

Add keyboard shortcut to focus the message input

Power users want to jump to the message input of the current conversation from anywhere in the window without the mouse. Add a shortcut (Cmd+L on macOS, Ctrl+L elsewhere) that focuses the input and selects nothing.

The shortcut must not trigger while a dialog is open, and it is listed in the keyboard shortcuts help.

Done when: the shortcut focuses the input from the file explorer, terminal and history; dialogs keep focus; the help lists it in both languages.

Secrets are visible in exported server settings

The Export settings button writes every server setting into a JSON file, including provider API keys in plain text. Users share these files when asking for help and leak their keys.

Exclude every setting whose name looks like a key, token, password or secret from the export, and say in the dialog that secrets are not included.

Done when: exported files contain no secret values; the import still works for the remaining settings; a unit test lists the excluded names.

Voice input transcribes the wrong language

Users who dictate in German get English nonsense because voice input always assumes English. Add a language choice to the voice input settings with automatic detection as the default, and pass it to the local speech model.

Done when: dictating German with automatic detection gives German text; a fixed language can be chosen; the choice is remembered; the voice extension download is unchanged.

Agent definitions cannot be duplicated

To create a variant of an agent, users copy its folder by hand and edit the id, which often breaks the definition. Add a Duplicate action on the agent card that creates a copy with a new id, the name suffixed with "copy", and the same tools, skills and instructions.

Done when: duplicating opens the editor of the new agent; the original is unchanged; duplicated definitions pass validation; teams keep pointing at the original.

Release workflow publishes the macOS build without notarization

The last release produced a macOS installer that Gatekeeper blocked because the notarization step was skipped when the Apple credentials secret was missing in the workflow environment. The job did not fail.

Make notarization mandatory for release tags and fail the job when credentials are missing.

Done when: a release tag without credentials fails before publishing; notarized builds open without a warning; the release guide documents the secrets.

Markdown tables overflow the conversation column

Wide Markdown tables in agent answers push the conversation column wider than the window, and the whole view scrolls sideways, including the message input.

Wrap tables in a horizontally scrollable container so only the table scrolls. Long cell text should still wrap where possible.

Done when: a table with twelve columns scrolls inside its own box; the message input stays in place; copy as Markdown still works.

Support MCP servers that need OAuth sign-in

Some remote MCP servers require an OAuth authorization before their tools can be listed. Today the connection simply fails with 401 and the server shows as offline.

Implement the MCP authorization flow: open the browser for consent, receive the callback, store the tokens in the secret vault and refresh them when they expire.

Done when: an OAuth-protected MCP server can be added and its tools used; tokens are never written in plain text; a revoked token shows a Sign in again action.

Workspace search is slow in large repositories

Searching file contents in a workspace with 200,000 files takes more than a minute and freezes the file explorer meanwhile. The search reads every file, including node_modules and build output.

Respect .gitignore and the built-in ignore list, stream results as they are found, and run the scan off the main thread.

Done when: the first results appear within two seconds in the reference repository; ignored folders are skipped; the explorer stays responsive during a search.

Team members cannot see each other's file changes

In a team run, when one member edits a file, the other members keep working with the old content because they never receive a notice about the change. Their later edits overwrite each other.

Tell every member of the same team which files another member changed, as a short note in their next turn.

Done when: a member that edits a file after another member gets the note; notes name the changed files and the member; no note is sent when nothing changed.

Crash when pasting a large image into the message input

Pasting a screenshot larger than 20 MB into the message input makes the renderer freeze and then crash. The image is converted to a data URL in memory several times.

Read pasted images as files, downscale previews, and refuse files above the provider's upload limit with a clear message.

Done when: pasting a 40 MB screenshot shows a size message instead of crashing; normal screenshots attach as before; memory stays stable.

Add Spanish translation of the app

The app is available in English and Simplified Chinese. Add Spanish for every screen, including settings, projects, history and errors, using the existing localization catalog.

Translations must use neutral Spanish. Missing keys fall back to English, and the localization guard must pass.

Done when: choosing Spanish in settings translates every screen; dates and numbers use Spanish formats; no literal English strings remain in components.

Agents keep retrying a failing tool forever

When a tool keeps returning the same error, for example a missing file, some agents call it again and again until the context is full. The run never stops on its own and burns tokens.

Detect repeated identical failing tool calls and stop the run after three in a row with a clear message to the user.

Done when: the third identical failure stops the run; different arguments do not count as repeats; the stop reason appears in the conversation and history.

Move the Applications page into the main navigation

Applications are hidden in a menu under settings, so most users never find them. Add an Applications entry to the left navigation, below Projects, with the same icon as the application cards.

The entry only shows when the applications capability is enabled for this node.

Done when: the entry appears in the left navigation; clicking it opens the applications page; it disappears when the capability is turned off.

Backup and restore of all app data

Users moving to a new computer have no way to take their agents, teams, projects, history and settings with them. Add an export of all app data into one archive and an import that restores it on another machine.

Secrets are only included when the user sets a password for the archive.

Done when: an archive made on one machine restores everything on another; restoring into a non-empty installation asks before replacing; the archive format is documented.

Group icon looks like a lightning bolt

The icon for agent teams in the left navigation and on team cards was replaced by mistake with the bolt icon used for quick actions. Users think teams are a power feature.

Restore the people-group icon everywhere teams are shown.

Done when: teams use the group icon in navigation, cards, history and pickers; quick actions keep the bolt; the icon test snapshot is updated.

Show which model each team member uses

In a team run it is not visible which LLM each member is using, so users cannot tell why one member is slow or expensive. Show the model name next to each member in the team panel and in the member's conversation header.

Done when: every member shows its model; members that inherit the team default say so; changing a member's model updates the label without a reload.

Proxy settings are ignored for provider requests

Users behind a corporate HTTP proxy cannot reach any LLM provider because the server's outgoing requests ignore HTTPS_PROXY and the system proxy. Only the desktop shell's own requests work.

Route provider, download and MCP requests through the configured proxy, with an exception list for local hosts.

Done when: requests go through the proxy when it is set; localhost model servers are reached directly; a test with a local proxy covers it.

Conversation history takes long to open

Opening a long conversation with thousands of messages takes several seconds because the whole history is loaded and rendered at once.

Load the last page of messages first and fetch older pages when the user scrolls up, keeping the scroll position stable.

Done when: a 5,000-message conversation opens in under a second; scrolling up loads older messages without jumps; search within the conversation still finds old messages.

Delegated task agents should report progress

When a coordinator delegates work, it has no idea how far the task agent is until the agent finishes. Users ask the coordinator for status and it guesses.

Let task agents send short progress notes to the agent that delegated to them, at most one every few minutes, and show the latest note on the task's card.

Done when: progress notes reach the delegating agent; the Task card shows the latest one; notes are rate limited and do not wake idle agents.

Settings page freezes when a provider is unreachable

Opening Settings waits for every LLM provider to list its models. When one local model server is down, the page stays blank for thirty seconds.

Load provider model lists independently and show each provider's own loading and error state.

Done when: settings open immediately with an offline provider; the offline provider shows an error with Retry; other providers list their models normally.

Allow choosing the default working folder for new agents

New agent runs always start in the home folder, and users then have to change the workspace every time. Add a setting for the default workspace of new runs, with the last used workspace as an option.

Done when: new runs start in the chosen folder; the last-used option follows the previous run; an invalid folder falls back to home with a notice.

Add a print view for Project Tasks

Some users plan work on paper and want to print a Project's open Tasks. Add a print layout that lists the Project's To Do and In Progress Tasks with their keys and full descriptions, one after another, without the app chrome.

Done when: printing from the Project page produces clean pages; long descriptions break across pages; done and cancelled Tasks are left out.

Server memory keeps growing during long runs

The server process grows from 400 MB to more than 3 GB over a day with several long agent runs. Heap snapshots show that every streamed token event of finished runs stays referenced by the run history cache.

Release the event buffers of finished runs and cap the cache.

Done when: memory returns close to the baseline after runs finish; a soak test of six hours stays under 1 GB; history pages still load.

Agents should be able to read PDF attachments

When a user attaches a PDF to a message, the agent only receives the file name. Extract the text of the PDF on the server and give it to the agent, with page numbers, up to a size limit. Scanned PDFs without text get a clear note.

Done when: an agent can answer questions about an attached text PDF; very large PDFs are truncated with a note; scanned PDFs are reported as images.

Clear error when the LLM API key is wrong

With a wrong or expired API key, the conversation shows a generic "Request failed" message and the agent seems to hang. Users do not know they have to fix the key.

Recognize authentication errors from every provider and show "The API key for this provider was rejected" with a link to its settings.

Done when: a wrong key shows the provider-specific message and settings link; the run stops; other errors keep their messages.

Contributors guide and code of conduct

The repository has no guidance for outside contributors. Add a CONTRIBUTING guide that explains the setup, the testing commands, the pull request checklist and the contributor licence agreement, plus a code of conduct.

Done when: CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md exist; the pull request template links them; the README has a Contributing section.

Pin important conversations in history

Users lose track of the few conversations they return to every day among hundreds of runs. Let them pin a conversation so it stays at the top of the history list, in a Pinned section.

Done when: pinning moves a run to the Pinned section; unpinning returns it to its date; pins are saved on the node and survive restarts.

Auto-update downloads the full installer every time

Every desktop update downloads the whole 300 MB installer, even for small fixes. Users on slow connections complain.

Enable differential updates with blockmaps on macOS and Windows so only changed blocks are downloaded.

Done when: a small update downloads less than 30 MB; a corrupt partial download falls back to the full file; release artifacts include the blockmaps.

Show a diff before an agent overwrites a file

Agents sometimes overwrite files with wrong content and users notice too late. In the run's file changes panel, show a side-by-side diff of every changed file with the content before the change, and allow reverting one file.

Done when: each changed file opens a diff; Revert restores the previous content; created and deleted files are shown as such.

Rate limit errors should wait and retry

When a provider answers 429 Too Many Requests, the run fails immediately. Most rate limits clear after a few seconds.

Retry rate-limited requests with backoff, honouring the Retry-After header, up to a maximum wait, and show "Waiting for the provider rate limit" in the conversation meanwhile.

Done when: a 429 with Retry-After is retried after that time; the user sees the waiting state; after the maximum wait the run fails with the provider's message.

Build a mobile app for iPhone

Offer a native iPhone app that shows the user's agent runs and lets them answer agents on the go. Login with the same node address.

Cancelled: the existing mobile web page wrapped in a thin shell covers the need.

Make the delete confirmation say what will be lost

Deleting a Project only asks "Are you sure?". Users have deleted Projects with many Tasks by accident.

Say in the dialog how many Tasks and saved context files will be removed, and require typing the Project name when it has more than ten Tasks.

Done when: the dialog shows the counts; large Projects require the name; workspaces on disk are never deleted and the dialog says so.

Schedule an agent to run every morning

Users want an agent to prepare a daily summary of their repositories before they start work. Add schedules: an agent, a message and a time pattern. The server starts a new run at that time when the node is running.

Done when: a daily schedule starts a run at the set time; missed times while the node was off are not replayed; schedules can be paused and deleted.

Unify the three different date formats

History shows dates as 18/10/2026, projects as Oct 18 and settings as 2026-10-18. Use one relative-then-absolute format everywhere, following the user's locale.

Done when: every list uses the shared date formatter; today and yesterday are relative; older dates use the locale's short date.

Agents ignore the repository's release rules

The delivery agent publishes releases without reading the RELEASE.md guide of the repository, so it skips required checks and tags the wrong branch.

Make the delivery engineer read the repository's release guide before merging or tagging, and follow its rules.

Done when: the delivery agent's instructions require reading the release guide; a dry run shows it following the guide's branch and tag rules.

Reduce the size of the desktop installer

The installer grew to 900 MB because every platform's native binaries and source maps are included. Remove the binaries of other platforms and the source maps from the packaged server.

Done when: each platform's installer contains only its own binaries; the packaged server starts on every platform; the installer is below 500 MB.

Agents need a tool to fetch web pages

Agents cannot read a URL the user pastes. Add a fetch tool that downloads a web page, extracts the readable text and returns it with the title, within a size limit, honoring robots rules and timeouts.

Done when: an agent can summarize a pasted article; binary and huge responses are refused with a message; the tool is available to definitions that select it.

Explain why an agent definition is invalid

When an agent definition has a mistake, for example an unknown tool name, it just disappears from the agent list. Users do not know why.

List invalid definitions in a Problems section with the file, the field and a readable reason.

Done when: a definition with an unknown tool shows in Problems with that tool's name; fixing the file removes it from Problems; valid definitions are unaffected.

Copy button for code blocks

Copying code from an agent's answer requires selecting it by hand, and the selection often includes line numbers. Add a Copy button to the top-right corner of every code block that copies the raw code.

Done when: the button copies exactly the code without line numbers; it shows Copied for two seconds; it is reachable by keyboard.

Node connection drops after changing networks

When the laptop switches from Wi-Fi to a phone hotspot, the app shows the node as disconnected forever. The connection to a remote node is never re-established after the network changes.

Reconnect with backoff when the network changes, and show a reconnecting banner meanwhile.

Done when: switching networks reconnects within ten seconds; the banner shows while reconnecting; runs continue streaming after the reconnect.

Let users choose where app data is stored

App data lives in the user's home folder, which is too small on some machines. Add a setting to move the app data folder to another disk, copying the existing data and restarting the server there.

Done when: choosing a new folder copies everything and restarts with it; the old folder is kept until the user removes it; a failed copy leaves the old location in use.

Conversation export to Markdown

Users want to share a conversation with colleagues who do not use the app. Add Export as Markdown to a run's menu: messages in order, tool calls collapsed into short lines, code blocks preserved.

Done when: the exported file opens cleanly in any Markdown viewer; images are referenced by file name; secrets in tool arguments are masked.

Tool approval prompts appear in the wrong conversation

When two agent runs are open in split view, a tool approval request of one run sometimes appears in the other run's panel, and approving it there approves the wrong call.

Route approval prompts by run id and show them only in their own run.

Done when: approvals show only in their run; approving in one panel never affects another run; a two-run test covers it.

Show the cost of a team run per member

After a team run, users want to know which member spent the most. Add a cost breakdown per member to the team run summary, using the same pricing as single runs.

Done when: the summary lists tokens and cost per member and the total; members without pricing show tokens only; the total matches the statistics page.

Skills should be updatable from their source

Skills installed from a Git repository never update. Add an Update action that pulls the newest version of an installed skill from its source, shows what changed and keeps local edits in a backup.

Done when: Update brings a skill to its source's latest version; local edits are kept in a backup folder; skills without a source show no Update action.

Notifications when a long run finishes

Users switch to other work while an agent runs for twenty minutes and miss when it finishes. Show a desktop notification when a run that took longer than a minute finishes or needs input, unless the app is focused on that run.

Done when: finished long runs notify; runs waiting for approval notify; clicking the notification opens the run; notifications can be turned off in settings.

Fix flaky server end-to-end tests on CI

About one in five CI runs fails in the server E2E suite with port already in use errors, because several tests start servers on fixed ports in parallel.

Give every test server a free port chosen at start, and clean up processes after each file.

Done when: twenty CI runs in a row pass; no test uses a fixed port; leftover processes are reported by the harness.

Projects need a description field shown on the board

A Project has only a name, so new team members do not know what it is for. Show the Project's description at the top of its board, editable inline, with Markdown support.

Done when: the description shows above the board; editing saves on blur; long descriptions collapse to three lines with Show more.

Agents should not run shell commands outside the workspace

The terminal tool lets an agent run commands in any folder, including the user's home and system folders. Restrict the working directory of agent commands to the run's workspace and its subfolders, unless the user allows more in settings.

Done when: commands outside the workspace are refused with a message; allowed extra folders work; the restriction is documented in the tool description.

Offline mode for local models

When the computer has no internet, the app shows errors for every provider and some screens do not load, even though local models through LM Studio or Ollama work.

Detect offline state, hide cloud providers' errors behind one notice, and keep local providers fully usable.

Done when: with the network off, local models can be chosen and used; one offline notice replaces provider errors; going online again restores cloud providers.
